schema_note: This document follows the wave10 function-handoff.v1 field set and adds five keys the wave10 shape did not need: the two decompilation_defects_corrected and unresolved_questions lists that carry the corrected evidence, observed_body.instruction_count_source, ghidra_provenance.binary_sha256 and implementation.boundary_test.
semantic_label: pair vector construct: point the inline arena at the payload, set the cursor and limit, then push the source range through the port

abi.frame: PUSH EBP / MOV EBP,ESP / SUB ESP,0x10
abi.return_contract: the receiver pointer read back from ECX, unchanged

observed_body.instruction_count_source: a linear objdump of the byte extent below; no staging handoff covered this address
instruction_list: zero the cursor, the limit and the inline sentinel at receiver + 0x04, + 0x08 and + 0x10
point the arena word at + 0x0c at the payload base at + 0x18
set the cursor to the inline base and the limit to the inline base plus 0x100
read the two source words and call the push port 0x004b7290 with them and the never written stale slot byte

mechanics: zero the cursor, the limit and the inline sentinel at receiver + 0x04, + 0x08 and + 0x10
point the arena word at + 0x0c at the payload base at + 0x18
set the cursor to the inline base and the limit to the inline base plus 0x100
read the two source words and call the push port 0x004b7290 with them and the never written stale slot byte
runtime_gates: the receiver class is unresolved; the target writes only the six header words of the pair vector
0x004b7290 is a dependency-only port, so the push is unverified in this package
the byte handed to the push port comes from a stack slot the body never writes, so its value is indeterminate in the original
decompilation_defects_corrected: the decompilation reports the inline sentinel as a written field; the assembly stores the inline base there, which is the cursor value and not a sentinel, so the corrected model stores the base
the stale slot byte is the same never written frame slot that 0x004ad6f0 hands to its fallback, so the model keeps it explicitly uninitialised rather than passing zero by accident

ghidra_provenance.evidence_rule: The disassembly listed in observed_body was read back from the live Ghidra database for SporeApp.exe at the addresses shown, and the byte extent, its length and its sha256 were computed from the .text section of SPORE/SporeBin/SporeApp.exe (.text VMA 0x00401000, file offset 0x400). The sha256 below covers exactly that byte extent; ghidra_provenance.binary_sha256 records the whole file. No Ghidra symbol, structure, comment or program state was created or modified.
